about: The reviewed documents of the retrieval corpus (spec 8, 'Planned corpus and retrieval'). scripts/build_corpus.py fetches each agency page, reads each project note from 'path', and writes manifest.json and sections/. 'drop_classes' names page furniture to leave out. Add a source only after reviewing it; no news, uploads or web search results.
